$comment: One effort scale for every vendor. The router chooses a normalized level (E0-E6) for the task, then each model card maps it onto that model's real setting. When a model doesn't support the exact level, the router rounds to the nearest supported one: up when quality is the priority, down for cost or speed.

levels.name: none
levels.meaning: No reasoning pass. Answer straight away. For lookups, formatting, and trivial rewrites.

levels.name: minimal
levels.meaning: A very brief think. For high-volume classification, extraction and routing.

levels.name: low
levels.meaning: Light reasoning. For chat, short edits, simple code, summaries. Fastest sensible default.

levels.name: medium
levels.meaning: Normal reasoning. For most real work: features, debugging, analysis, writing with structure.

levels.name: high
levels.meaning: Deep reasoning. For multi-file changes, tricky bugs, research synthesis, strict instruction following.

levels.name: xhigh
levels.meaning: Very deep reasoning. For long-horizon agentic coding and hard architecture. Only when a lower level measurably fails.

levels.name: max
levels.meaning: Uncapped. Use only when correctness matters far more than cost and time.

anthropic.notes: Current Claude models have no true 'off'. To think less, lower the effort; don't ask in the prompt. Sonnet 5.5 can switch thinking off with thinking:{type:'between_tools'} at high effort or below.

openai.notes: GPT-6 dropped 'minimal' (use 'low'); some models reject 'none'. Each card's effort.levels is the source of truth. reasoning.mode='pro' (GPT-5.6/GPT-6) is a separate switch for the hardest problems.

app_mappings.$comment: In chat apps you don't set an API parameter. You pick a mode instead. This is what to tell users.
app_mappings.claude.ai: Choose the model in the model picker. For E4+ turn on Extended thinking (or pick the higher effort option where shown).
app_mappings.claude-code: Model: /model <alias> (e.g. /model sonnet). Effort: /effort <low|medium|high|xhigh|max>, or the arrows in the /model picker.
app_mappings.chatgpt: Pick the model in the model menu (paid plans default to GPT-6 Sol) and raise the Thinking level for E3+. GPT-6 Pro (Astra) on Pro/Business/Enterprise for E5-E6.
app_mappings.codex: Pick the model with /model. Effort labels: Light, Medium, High, Extra High, Max (and Ultra, which splits work across subagents). Config: model and model_reasoning_effort in ~/.codex/config.toml.
